prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in automatically restores your saved pet memory, active traits, and cloud sync across all devices."]
1: ["Master Desktop Pet Commands", "Press Option+Space to summon your pet, Option+H to hide, or Option+V to talk instantly.", "Option+Space: Summon Pet", "Option+H: Hide to Tray", "Option+V: Voice Interaction"]
2: ["Quick System Controls & Shortcuts", "Your pet lives in your desktop system tray. Practice toggling controls below before getting started.", "Test System Tray Hide (Option+H)", "Test Voice Command (Option+V)"]
3: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "We are assembling animations, personality traits, and sound profiles for your pet."]
4: ["Logging in connects your cloud account so your pet profile, level, and items are never reset or lost."]
5: ["Desktop Pet Control Practice", "Try out pet commands right now on your desktop overlay before completing setup.", "Summon Pet Overlay", "Toggle Quiet Mode"]
6: ["Generating 3D mesh and trait audio... This usually takes 30-60 seconds."]
7: ["Managing Desktop Pet Visibility", "If your pet disappears or desktop focus shifts, click the tray icon or use Option+H to toggle visibility instantly.", "1. System Tray Icon: Click to show/hide context menu.", "2. Global Hotkey: Option+H toggles desktop visibility."]
8: ["If photo trait synthesis encounters issues, default aesthetic presets will be automatically applied so your pet loads smoothly."]
9: ["Your selected path determines your pet's starting personality traits, background story, and initial hotkey actions."]
